props.--rule-fade:
linear-gradient(
		to right,
		transparent,
		color-mix(in srgb, light-dark(#000000, #f2f2f2) 10%, transparent) 16%,
		color-mix(in srgb, light-dark(#000000, #f2f2f2) 10%, transparent) 84%,
		transparent
	)
props.--aero-lit:
inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6), inset 0 8px 12px -8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65),
		inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25),
		0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, light-dark(#000000, #f2f2f2) 5%, transparent), 0 1px 3px rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.07),
		0 4px 12px rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.08)
